thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 03:12 UTC - infer-prod-eu-1: GPU OOM prefill surge. 12 container restarts in 6m. Rule=container_restart_count>10. Paging oncall_ryan.
ryan_oncall: i'm oncall — acknowledging. @maya_sre @sam_runtime can you triage? any immediate mitigations? :rotating_light:
maya_sre: grabbing logs now from gpu-07 and gpupool-3. seeing repeated CUDA errors and SIGKILL during prefill. looks like large context prefill requests are spiking.
sam_runtime: confirm — metric prefills_per_min jumped x8 after a release that changed client-side streaming; many requests with long system prompts + large doc uploads. KV cache allocations hit ~15.4GB on GPU. snippet from runtime log:
```
[2026-03-15T03:10:21Z] ERROR prefill: failed to allocate kv cache: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
backtrace: prefill_alloc -> kv_cache_init -> cudaMalloc
[2026-03-15T03:10:21Z] WARN container: restarting container id=pod/infer-xyz-7 due to OOM
```

tom_infra: could be memory fragmentation + big prefill spikes. node-level dmesg shows driver reset on gpu-07: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:06:00): 79` — driver reset code.
lina_mlops: immediate mitigation idea: set runtime config override on affected pool to cap prefill tokens and enable aggressive eviction. Proposed patch: `prefill_max_tokens: 15000 -> 4000`, `prefill_kv_cache_limit_mb: 13000 -> 8000`, `eviction_policy: conservative -> aggressive`. We can rollout to infer-prod-eu-1 pool in 2m via console.
ryan_oncall: do it. Also enable fallback to coldmodel for the heaviest requests if allocation fails — can we enable `cold_fallback:true`?
sam_runtime: yes, we have fallback code. I'll flip `cold_fallback:true` and `cold_fallback_threshold_mb:12000`. That should let requests continue albeit higher latency. Applying now.
jen_support: what's customer impact? are any requests returning 5xx? do we need to notify customers?
customer_alerts_bot: automated customer-impact check: 4 customers with high-usage keys have >2% 5xx in last 5m (acct: acme-corp, beta-ai, quickchat, docsynth). Estimated error window started 03:06 UTC.
maya_sre: patch applied to pool (prefill_max_tokens=4000, kv_limit=8000). also restarted palm instances on gpupool-3 gracefully. restarts dropped from 12->2 in the last 3m.
sam_runtime: confirming fallbacks enabled. traffic now routes heavy requests to coldmodel when allocation would exceed threshold. error-rate trending down.
tom_infra: cordoned node gpu-07 to prevent new pods landing while we do deeper kernel/driver triage: `kubectl cordon gpu-07`. Snapshots saved: `/srv/logs/gpu-07/oom-20260315.tar.gz`.
ryan_oncall: good. action log so far: 1) patched pool config to cap prefill tokens 2) enabled cold fallback 3) cordoned node 4) restarted pods gracefully. Anyone see recurrence?
lina_mlops: still seeing a few borderline OOMs for specific requests that craft huge system prompts. Suggest adding a per-request token hard cap at the gateway level as a longer-term prod fix. I'll open a PR to enforce `max_total_prompt_tokens=50000` at ingress.
jen_support: prepping customer comms: draft message to affected customers explaining transient errors due to long-context requests, mitigation (fallback to coldmodel) and ETA for full fix. Do we have an RCA yet?
maya_sre: initial RCA (high level): a recent client-side streaming change allowed concatenated docs to bypass per-request token validation; this produced bursts of very large prefill allocations that, combined with GPU memory fragmentation, triggered CUDA driver resets and container restarts. Root causes: 1) no strict token cap at ingress 2) fragmentation on long-lived GPU kernels 3) insufficient eviction aggressiveness for prefill.
sam_runtime: quick follow-ups I ran: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/infer-pool-eu --namespace=inference` for a clean runtime memory state; adjusted runtime to reclaim KV cache more aggressively after prefill.
ryan_oncall: handing off to night oncall: @emma_night (copied offline). Before handoff: ensure cluster autoscaler has a 2x burst policy enabled, keep gpu-07 cordoned until infra confirms driver health, and keep customer comm draft in support queue.
jen_support: ack — sending initial notices to the 4 impacted customers with link to status page and workaround.
customer_alerts_bot: sent customer-notice to acme-corp, beta-ai, quickchat, docsynth at 03:24 UTC.
lina_mlops: created ticket INF-7892 to implement ingress token caps + add prefill size metric and alert. tagging eng-runtime and api-gateway.
maya_sre: we should run a memdefrag workload on gpu-07 once uncordoned (nv-persistence mode check + driver patch scheduled).
ryan_oncall: final status: mitigation applied, errors dropping, no ongoing restarts. Follow-up items: postmortem, ingress hard cap, driver check on gpu-07, eviction policy tuning. I'll update incident channel and create postmortem doc. handing to night team — please escalate if restarts resume. :thumbsup:
sam_runtime: leaving a short snippet of commands used for handoff:
```
# cordon node
kubectl cordon gpu-07
# restart runtime pods in pool
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/infer-pool-eu
# patch runtime config
redwoodctl patch pool infer-prod-eu-1 --set prefill_max_tokens=4000 --set prefill_kv_cache_limit_mb=8000
```

jen_support: closing customer comm loop — they confirmed degraded UX but accepted workaround for now.
incident-bot: incident state -> mitigated (03:30 UTC). Next: postmortem required.
ryan_oncall: thanks everyone. i'll file the postmortem with timeline and assign owners for the three follow-ups. handing off.
